name: bridges
description: Lets one Space share with another on purpose: a shared view, a reference, an event projection, a copy, a Kit or a hand-off task. Both Spaces agree, nothing sealed crosses, and either side can stop it at once.

tools.name: bridges.propose-view
tools.summary: Offer another Space a live, read-only view of chosen fields.

tools.name: bridges.propose-reference
tools.summary: Let another Space show the names of chosen records.

tools.name: bridges.propose-projection
tools.summary: Send chosen fields of chosen events to another Space.

tools.name: bridges.accept
tools.summary: Accept what another Space offered to share.

tools.name: bridges.revoke
tools.summary: Stop a share at once, from either side.

tools.name: bridges.list
tools.summary: The shares a Space is part of, on both sides.

tools.name: bridges.get
tools.summary: One share a Space is part of.

tools.name: bridges.view.read
tools.summary: Read a shared view through its source Space.

tools.name: bridges.resolve
tools.summary: Look up the name behind a reference to another Space.

tools.name: bridges.copy
tools.summary: Copy a record into another Space you belong to.

tools.name: bridges.project
tools.summary: Deliver one event through a projection.

tools.name: bridges.kit.plan
tools.summary: List everything a Kit would add to a Space.

tools.name: bridges.kit.install
tools.summary: Install a Kit after its plan was approved.

tools.name: bridges.continue
tools.summary: Hand work to another Space as a task that points back.

tools.name: bridges.session.policy
tools.summary: The rules of a session that draws on more than one Space.

tools.name: bridges.merge.links
tools.summary: One link per Space a person belongs to, for a device to read and merge itself.
